ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Bumps the 'Checkout shipwright-compliance plugin (pinned)' step's ref from svenroth-ai/shipwright@7e106939fbf82331f5e54a4ea27d90b4f279f1ce (main, 2026-09-06) to the exact SHA c0d1b38be27730dca4c9f00afc4538dd10f76e56 (PR #686: AC-scoped @covers tag grammar + test-traceability manifest schema v4, additive per that schema's own docstring). Third-party (non-GitHub-owned) SHA pin per DO-NOT #25's asymmetric posture -- stays SHA-pinned, no tag/branch. Provenance verified three ways after a fresh fetch: (1) 'gh api repos/svenroth-ai/shipwright/commits/<sha>' resolves; (2) 'git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> origin/main' exits 0; (3) 'gh api repos/svenroth-ai/shipwright/commits/<sha>/pulls' returns exactly PR #686 with merge_commit_sha equal to this same SHA -- the pinned commit IS PR #686's own merge commit, not merely a later commit. Compatibility verified: the three pinned upstream symbols the gate's own re-pin comment names (build_manifest, _validate_manifest, _test_links_io.{configured_test_roots,configured_prune_dirs,git_head}) resolve with backward-compatible signatures, corroborated by the authoritative test -- traceability_manifest_gate.py run locally against this exact pinned checkout reports 'manifest is current' once the manifest is regenerated (schema_version 3 to 4, byte-identical shape otherwise -- 0 of 33 requirements carry acs, since no AC-scoped tags exist yet in this repo). CORRECTED at F11: the regenerated manifest does NOT ship in this commit -- check_no_derived_snapshots_committed forbids it -- so main's push-triggered gate is expected to go red for one cycle immediately after this PR merges; the fix is a same-day main-repair PR regenerating the manifest, mirroring PR #443/#444 earlier this run. Confirmed via grep across .github/workflows/*.yml that this checkout is consumed by exactly one job/step -- no other workflow step shares this pin. No credential change, no permissions widening, no new third-party action added. Note: this job is guarded 'event_name != pull_request', so it never runs on this PR itself (observed 'skipping' on prior PR #444) -- the local reproduction above is the authoritative pre-merge check; the real push-triggered exercise on main after merge is proactively verified post-merge rather than assumed. Fallback if that post-merge run goes red -- THREE-BRANCH diagnosis (see mini-plan step 5 for full detail, and external code-review round 5 which caught this ack's own earlier one-branch summary as stale): (A) pin/schema-shape mismatch -> ATOMIC revert of both the ref and the manifest together via main-repair (reverting only the ref would leave a v4-shaped manifest the reinstated v3-only collector cannot produce, re-failing the gate the other way); (B) ordinary content drift (new/changed/untagged tests landed on main after this regen, unrelated to the pin) -> plain re-regen against the still-valid pin, NOT a revert; (C) checkout/fetch failure (pinned SHA becomes unreachable) -> fail-closed by design, re-verify pin reachability the same three ways as the original pin and re-pin.
